command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: Task 2.2 not done as written: it says "Add `LOCATION_MENU_VIEWPORT_MARGIN_PX = 4` to `src/constants/grid.ts` and export it from `src/constants/index.ts`", and design D1 uses it in roomBelow/roomAbove. The constant exists nowhere. Instead there are two local aliases: `const VIEWPORT_MARGIN_PX = LOCATION_MENU_OFFSET_PX;` in packages/client/src/views/shared/locationMenuPlacement.ts:4, and the same line in packages/client/src/test/features/grid_view/steps/grid_view_layers_e2e.steps.ts:38, although task 3.4 says that step uses `LOCATION_MENU_VIEWPORT_MARGIN_PX`. That is a duplicated constant with no single owner (code-style.md: "Is any value repeated in 2+ places? → Must be a constant"; glossary rule: one owner per concept). The function signature also differs from D1, which specifies `getLocationMenuPlacement({ buttonTopPx, buttonBottomPx, menuHeightPx, viewportHeightPx })`; the code takes positional `(buttonBox, menuHeightPx, viewportHeightPx)`.

Tasks 4.1/4.2 and design D3 are ticked but not implemented as specified. D3: "`useMeetingShare(textSharing, onMeetingShared?)` gains an optional second parameter. `finishShare` calls it after closing the dialog when the outcome is `ShareOutcome.SHARED`". Task 4.2: "extract `clearMeetingAndFocusAddLocation` ... use it for the meeting bar's Clear meeting and pass it as `onMeetingShared`". In the code, packages/client/src/controller/useMeetingShare.ts is unchanged (no parameter, finishShare untouched), AppShell.tsx:116 still calls `useMeetingShare(textSharing)`, and no `clearMeetingAndFocusAddLocation` exists; AppShell.tsx:177-180 keeps the inline onClear lambda. The callback lives in useMeetingShareDialog.ts:60/164 instead. The glossary entry for Share meeting was rewritten to `useMeetingShareDialog (onMeetingShared)`, contrary to task 1.1, which says *Code:* becomes `useMeetingShare` (open flag, notice, `onMeetingShared`). Either align the code with D3/tasks or update design.md/tasks.md (via the change) so artifacts and code agree.

Task 3.1 says to keep the existing cases, including "forget on close", and to add a test that "one opening reads the button's `getBoundingClientRect` once" (NFR-P1: "reads the layout of its button and of the menu once"). useLocationMenuPlacement.test.ts has no forget-on-close case, and the hook (useLocationMenuPlacement.ts:41-79) never resets its state when isOpen becomes false, so the previous opening's side, fixed top/bottom and maxHeight carry over into the next opening until it re-measures. Restore the reset on close and its test, and add an assertion that the menu's scrollHeight is read once per opening and per event.
